summary: Implementation conforms to all ten FRs, all acceptance scenarios, edge cases, contracts and all eight tasks with correct red proofs; one low advisory inaccuracy in the recorded evidence counts.

findings.summary: Recorded evidence counts (160 files compared, 146 byte-identical) do not match the tracked distribution (165 files, so 151 byte-identical plus the 14 expected changes), leaving the substantive compatibility conclusion intact but the arithmetic misrecorded.
findings.evidence: quickstart.md T002 records '(160 files)' and T006 'compared all 160 final files against T002: 146 byte-identical, exactly 14 changed' (146+14=160); git ls-tree -r origin/main and git ls-files dist/ both count 165 tracked dist files at base and HEAD, and git diff --diff-filter=A/D -- dist/ shows 0 additions and 0 deletions, so the identical-file count is 151, not 146. The substantive claim was independently verified true: exactly the nine dist/opencode/agents/*.md and the five skill/references/harness/opencode.md bundles changed, all five bundles byte-identical to adapters/opencode/harness.md, and git status --porcelain -- dist/ is empty. FR-009/T007 demand accurately reported evidence; only the file counts are off, no category outcome or contract result is affected.
findings.fix: Correct the two counts in quickstart.md to the tracked tree (165 files compared, 151 byte-identical, 14 changed), or record how the 160 count was derived (e.g. an exclusion used by the baseline snapshot) so the arithmetic is reproducible.
